outcome: admission to an intensive care unit
cohort: 35 pregnant women who experienced postpartum hemorrhage after vaginal delivery or cesarean section between February 1 and October 31, 2016, in a public intermediate complexity institution in Bogotá
finding: The incidence of postpartum hemorrhage was 2.1%, and the main cause was uterine hypotonia (82%), with most cases resolving with medical treatment.
